facts.value: Organized in 1860 after ministers and members in the Genesee Conference of western New York denounced a decline of spirituality in the Methodist Episcopal Church. Its founders aimed to keep the usage and spirit of early Methodism.

citations.excerpt: It was the purpose of the founders to conserve the usage and the spirit of primitive Methodism.

A number of ministers and members within the bounds of the Genesee Conference, in Western New York, in 1850, began to deplore and denounce the decline of spirituality in the Methodist Episcopal Church.

facts.value_before_verify: Founded by ministers expelled after protesting a decline of spirituality in the Methodist Episcopal Church, aiming to keep early Methodist practice.
